_regions: Bounding boxes in SOURCE pixel space, used to classify traced subpaths. A subpath matches a region when its own bbox satisfies every bound the region specifies, so a region may be a half-plane (y0 only) or a full box. Re-derive these with `npm run inspect` if the artwork ever changes.
_variants: Each entry is one emitted SVG. `drop` lists regions whose subpaths are removed before reframing.
